fidelity.measurement_method: Because there is no bridge, the chokepoint is the LEGACY RECORD, not an event. Measured by counting each L0 field name in DoorTypes.ts (the legacy DoorData) and in DoorBuilder.ts.
fidelity.where_those_three_ARE_read: packages/geometry-kernel/src/producers/door.ts and packages/geometry-lift/src/LiftAssembly.ts — i.e. `frameMaterialId` and `leafMaterialId` have exactly one geometry consumer each and it is ON THE UNREACHABLE SIDE. Repo-wide counts (excluding packages/schemas and tests): frameMaterialId 27, leafMaterialId 8 — all in the producer half, the CEB's lift fan-out, and UI/AI vocabulary files.
fidelity.the_shape_of_the_defect: C100 §2.1's split is 'materialId is the master id, materialColor the resolved hex cache'. Door implements the CACHE half (frameColor, leafColor → drawn) and not the MASTER half (frameMaterialId, leafMaterialId → nowhere). So a door can be given a colour but not a material: change the master material library and the door does not follow.
fidelity.draws_what_the_user_authored: MOSTLY — 8 of 18 fields drawn, 2 carried as metadata, 3 with no destination at all, 5 provenance/host ids.
